# Glossary {.unnumbered}

This appendix lists the terms used throughout the book: one term, one spelling, one definition.
The Term column holds the English word and the Indonesian column holds the Indonesian word, and
every row names the chapter where the term appears. When the chapter has its own page, its name
becomes a link.

| Term | Indonesian | Definition | Chapter |
|---|---|---|---|
| `compiler` | compiler | a program that translates source code into a binary | [Variables: `var`, `let`, `const`](../chapters/variables.qmd) |
| `compile time` | compile-time | while compilation runs; before the program starts | [Variables: `var`, `let`, `const`](../chapters/variables.qmd) |
| `runtime` | runtime | while the program is running | [Variables: `var`, `let`, `const`](../chapters/variables.qmd) |
| `value` | nilai | the content stored in a variable | [Variables: `var`, `let`, `const`](../chapters/variables.qmd) |
| `variable` | variabel | a name for a value | [Variables: `var`, `let`, `const`](../chapters/variables.qmd) |
| `constant` | konstanta | a value that does not change | [Variables: `var`, `let`, `const`](../chapters/variables.qmd) |
| `data type` | tipe data | the kind of a value; it decides which operations are valid and how much memory it uses | [Variables: `var`, `let`, `const`](../chapters/variables.qmd) |
| `declaration` | deklarasi | a statement that introduces a new name | [Variables: `var`, `let`, `const`](../chapters/variables.qmd) |
| `initialization` | inisialisasi | filling in the first value | [Variables: `var`, `let`, `const`](../chapters/variables.qmd) |
| `string interpolation` | interpolasi string | inserting values into text | [Variables: `var`, `let`, `const`](../chapters/variables.qmd) |
| `identifier` | identifier | a name for a variable, type, procedure, or module | [Variables: `var`, `let`, `const`](../chapters/variables.qmd) |
| `error message` | pesan error | compiler output that explains a problem | [Variables: `var`, `let`, `const`](../chapters/variables.qmd) |
| `procedure` | prosedur | a routine that may have side effects (`proc`) | - |
| `function` | fungsi | a routine with no side effects (`func`) | - |
| `loop` | perulangan | a construct that repeats a block of code | - |
| `branching` | percabangan | choosing which path to execute (`if`, `case`, `when`) | - |
| `array` | larik | a fixed-size collection of elements of the same type | - |
| `sequence` | barisan | a dynamically sized collection of elements of the same type (`seq`) | - |
| `object` | objek | a composite type with named fields | - |
| `exception` | pengecualian | an error condition that can be caught | - |
| `iterator` | iterator | an object that yields values one at a time (`yield`) | [Loops: `for`, `while`, `break`, `continue`](../chapters/loops.qmd) |
| `range` | rentang | the bounds from start to end (`a..b`, `a..<b`) | [Loops: `for`, `while`, `break`, `continue`](../chapters/loops.qmd) |
| `index` | indeks | the position of an element in a collection, starting at 0 | [`array`, `seq`, and `openArray`](../chapters/collections.qmd) |
| `element` | elemen | a single value inside a collection | [`array`, `seq`, and `openArray`](../chapters/collections.qmd) |
| `literal` | literal | a value written directly in code (`42`, `"text"`, `@[1, 2]`) | [Primitive types and literals](../chapters/primitive-types.qmd) |
| `expression` | ekspresi | a piece of code that produces a value | [Branching: `if`, `case`, `when`](../chapters/conditionals.qmd) |
| `statement` | pernyataan | a unit of code that does something, not always producing a value | [Branching: `if`, `case`, `when`](../chapters/conditionals.qmd) |
| `parameter` | parameter | the name of a value a procedure receives | [Procedures, parameters, and return values](../chapters/procedures.qmd) |
| `default value` | nilai default | the value used when an argument is not given | [Procedures, parameters, and return values](../chapters/procedures.qmd) |
| `inclusive` | inklusif | the end bound counts (`0..5` includes 5) | [Loops: `for`, `while`, `break`, `continue`](../chapters/loops.qmd) |
| `exclusive` | eksklusif | the end bound does not count (`0..<5` stops at 4) | [Loops: `for`, `while`, `break`, `continue`](../chapters/loops.qmd) |
| `ordinal type` | tipe ordinal | a type whose values can be ordered and counted (`int`, `char`, `enum`) | [Enums and sets](../chapters/enums-and-sets.qmd) |
| `stack trace` | jejak tumpukan | the list of calls shown when the program stops on a defect | [`array`, `seq`, and `openArray`](../chapters/collections.qmd) |
| `binary` | biner | the compiled file a machine can run | [What Nim is and why](../chapters/what-is-nim.qmd) |
| `virtual machine` | mesin virtual | a software layer that runs code on top of the CPU | [What Nim is and why](../chapters/what-is-nim.qmd) |
| `backend` | backend | a compiler output target (C, C++, JavaScript) | [What Nim is and why](../chapters/what-is-nim.qmd) |
| `debug build` | debug build | a build with all checks on, used while developing | [Workflow: `nim r`, `nimble`, editor](../chapters/workflow.qmd) |
| `release build` | release build | an optimized build, used when shipping the program | [Workflow: `nim r`, `nimble`, editor](../chapters/workflow.qmd) |
| `garbage collector` | garbage collector | the automatic memory manager in the classic GC mode | [What Nim is and why](../chapters/what-is-nim.qmd) |
| `destructor` | destruktor | a `=destroy` procedure called when a value is dropped | [What Nim is and why](../chapters/what-is-nim.qmd) |
| `scope` | ruang lingkup | the region of code where a name can be used | [Comments and doc comments](../chapters/comments.qmd) |
| `line comment` | komentar baris | a `#` comment to the end of the line | [Comments and doc comments](../chapters/comments.qmd) |
| `block comment` | komentar blok | a `#[ ... ]#` comment that can nest | [Comments and doc comments](../chapters/comments.qmd) |
| `doc comment` | doc comment | a `##` comment that `nim doc` reads | [Comments and doc comments](../chapters/comments.qmd) |
| `package manager` | pengelola paket | a tool that installs and manages dependencies (`nimble`) | [Installing Nim](../chapters/installation.qmd) |
| `standard library` | pustaka standar | the set of modules that ship with the compiler | [Installing Nim](../chapters/installation.qmd) |
| `project scaffold` | perancah proyek | the file skeleton that `nimble init` creates | [Installing Nim](../chapters/installation.qmd) |
| `escape sequence` | escape sequence | a `\` plus a letter that stands for a special character (`\n`, `\t`) | [Strings, raw strings, and characters](../chapters/strings.qmd) |
| `raw string` | raw string | an `r"..."` string that does not process escapes | [Strings, raw strings, and characters](../chapters/strings.qmd) |
| `multiline string` | string multi-baris | a `"""..."""` string that keeps line breaks | [Strings, raw strings, and characters](../chapters/strings.qmd) |
| `slicing` | slicing | taking a piece of a string or collection by an index range | [Strings, raw strings, and characters](../chapters/strings.qmd) |
| `overflow` | overflow | a value that crosses a type bound and ends in `OverflowDefect` | [Primitive types and literals](../chapters/primitive-types.qmd) |
| `short-circuit evaluation` | evaluasi singkat | `and`/`or` stop as soon as the result is settled | [Arithmetic, comparison, and logic operators](../chapters/operators.qmd) |
| `bitwise` | bitwise | a per-bit operation (`and`, `or`, `xor`, `shl`, `shr`) | [Arithmetic, comparison, and logic operators](../chapters/operators.qmd) |
| `membership` | keanggotaan | an `in`/`notin` test on a collection or a range | [Arithmetic, comparison, and logic operators](../chapters/operators.qmd) |
| `precision` | presisi | the number of significant digits a float type guarantees | [Primitive types and literals](../chapters/primitive-types.qmd) |
| `type conversion` | konversi tipe | changing a value into another type (`int()`, `float()`, `$`) | [Primitive types and literals](../chapters/primitive-types.qmd) |
| `newline` | baris baru | the `\n` character that moves output to the next line | [Printing and formatting output](../chapters/printing.qmd) |
| `tuple` | tuple | a fixed-order collection of values of different types | [Tuples and destructuring](../chapters/tuples.qmd) |
| `destructuring` | destructuring | taking a tuple apart into separate variables | [Tuples and destructuring](../chapters/tuples.qmd) |
| `enum` | enum | a type with a fixed list of named values | [Enums and sets](../chapters/enums-and-sets.qmd) |
| `set` | himpunan | a collection of distinct values of an ordinal type (`set[Color]`) | [Enums and sets](../chapters/enums-and-sets.qmd) |
| `ordinal value` | nilai ordinal | the numeric position of an enum value (`ord(green)`) | [Enums and sets](../chapters/enums-and-sets.qmd) |
| `bitset` | himpunan bit | a set stored as bits, used for flags | [Enums and sets](../chapters/enums-and-sets.qmd) |
| `constructor` | konstruktor | the expression that builds an object value (`Person(name: ...)`) | [Objects and constructors](../chapters/objects.qmd) |
| `overloading` | overloading | several same-named procedures with different parameter lists | [Procedures, parameters, and return values](../chapters/procedures.qmd) |
| `return value` | nilai balik | the value a procedure returns | [Procedures, parameters, and return values](../chapters/procedures.qmd) |
| `side effect` | efek samping | a change beyond the return value (`echo`, writing a file, mutating a `var`) | [Procedures, parameters, and return values](../chapters/procedures.qmd) |
| `named argument` | argumen bernama | an argument written together with its parameter name | [Procedures, parameters, and return values](../chapters/procedures.qmd) |
| `reference` | referensi | a value that points to an object on the heap (`ref object`) | [Objects and constructors](../chapters/objects.qmd) |
| `value copy` | salinan nilai | copying the contents of a value, not its address | [Objects and constructors](../chapters/objects.qmd) |
| `closure` | closure | a procedure that carries the variables around it | [Closures and captured variables](../chapters/closures.qmd) |
| `anonymous procedure` | prosedur anonim | a nameless procedure used as a value | [Closures and captured variables](../chapters/closures.qmd) |
| `capture` | menangkap | a closure using a variable from an outer scope | [Closures and captured variables](../chapters/closures.qmd) |
| `calling convention` | konvensi pemanggilan | the rules for how a procedure is called (`nimcall`, `closure`) | [Closures and captured variables](../chapters/closures.qmd) |
| `hygienic` | higienis | a macro or template that does not leak names to the caller | [Templates: code expanded by the compiler](../chapters/templates.qmd) |
| `template expansion` | ekspansi template | template code copied by the compiler to the call site | [Templates: code expanded by the compiler](../chapters/templates.qmd) |
| `generic instantiation` | instansiasi generic | forming a concrete type from a generic at the point of use | [Generics: types and procedures](../chapters/generics.qmd) |
| `typedesc` | typedesc | a type as a value, used for type-based overloading | [Generics: types and procedures](../chapters/generics.qmd) |
| `pointer` | penunjuk | a value that stores a memory address (`ptr`) | [`ref`, `ptr`, and `nil`](../chapters/refs-and-pointers.qmd) |
| `address` | alamat | the location of a value in memory, obtained with `addr` | [`ref`, `ptr`, and `nil`](../chapters/refs-and-pointers.qmd) |
| `dereference` | dereferensi | reading the value a pointer points to | [`ref`, `ptr`, and `nil`](../chapters/refs-and-pointers.qmd) |
| `reference counting` | penghitungan referensi | counting the users of a value to know when to free it | [Memory management: ARC, ORC, and `=destroy`](../chapters/memory-management.qmd) |
| `memory management mode` | mode memori | the compiler's choice of memory manager (`--mm:arc`, `--mm:orc`) | [Memory management: ARC, ORC, and `=destroy`](../chapters/memory-management.qmd) |
| `resource` | sumber daya | something that must be released after use (a file, a socket) | [Files, directories, and OS](../chapters/files-and-os.qmd) |
| `module` | modul | a file or folder that holds code and can be imported | [Modules, `import`, and `export`](../chapters/modules.qmd) |
| `namespace` | ruang nama | a region of names kept apart by module | [Modules, `import`, and `export`](../chapters/modules.qmd) |
| `import` | mengimpor | using the contents of another module | [Modules, `import`, and `export`](../chapters/modules.qmd) |
| `export` | mengekspor | marking a module symbol that may be used from outside | [Modules, `import`, and `export`](../chapters/modules.qmd) |
| `effect` | efek | a procedure trait the compiler can check (`raises`) | [Exceptions and the `raises` effect](../chapters/exceptions.qmd) |
| `facade` | fasad | a thin module that unites several other modules | [Modules, `import`, and `export`](../chapters/modules.qmd) |
| `macro` | macro | a compile-time procedure that takes and produces an AST | [Macros: code that builds code](../chapters/macros.qmd) |
| `abstract syntax tree` | pohon sintaksis | a tree structure that represents source code | [Macros: code that builds code](../chapters/macros.qmd) |
| `quote do` | `quote do` | a macro block that writes code as usual | [Macros: code that builds code](../chapters/macros.qmd) |
| `untyped` | untyped | a macro parameter received before type checking | [Macros: code that builds code](../chapters/macros.qmd) |
| `concept` | konsep | a requirement on the shape of a type, checked during overloading | [Concepts and type matching](../chapters/concepts.qmd) |
| `variant object` | object varian | an object whose fields depend on a single tag | [Variant objects and `distinct`](../chapters/variants-and-distinct.qmd) |
| `distinct` | distinct | a new type with the same representation that does not interchange | [Variant objects and `distinct`](../chapters/variants-and-distinct.qmd) |
| `type alias` | alias tipe | another name for an existing type, with no new type | [Variant objects and `distinct`](../chapters/variants-and-distinct.qmd) |
| `file` | berkas | a unit of storage in the file system | [Files, directories, and OS](../chapters/files-and-os.qmd) |
| `directory` | direktori | a container for files and other directories | [Files, directories, and OS](../chapters/files-and-os.qmd) |
| `path` | jalur | the location of a file in the file system | [Files, directories, and OS](../chapters/files-and-os.qmd) |
| `environment variable` | variabel lingkungan | a configuration value from the parent process | [Files, directories, and OS](../chapters/files-and-os.qmd) |
| `thread` | utas | a path of execution inside one process | [`async`/`await` and IO](../chapters/async.qmd) |
| `event loop` | putaran peristiwa | the scheduler of async tasks in one thread | [`async`/`await` and IO](../chapters/async.qmd) |
| `suite` | suite | a group of tests in `unittest` | [`unittest` and test discipline](../chapters/unit-testing.qmd) |
| `test case` | kasus uji | one check inside a suite | [`unittest` and test discipline](../chapters/unit-testing.qmd) |
| `foreign function interface` | FFI | a way to call code from another language, here C | [FFI to C](../chapters/ffi-c.qmd) |
| `application binary interface` | ABI | the rules for layout and calls at the binary level | [FFI to C](../chapters/ffi-c.qmd) |
| `browser` | peramban | the program that runs the output of a JavaScript build | [Compiling to JavaScript](../chapters/js-backend.qmd) |
| `subcommand` | subperintah | a second command inside a CLI tool (`tool add`) | [CLI tools with `parseopt`](../chapters/cli-tools.qmd) |
| `option` | opsi | a named argument that changes a command's behaviour (`--count=4`) | [CLI tools with `parseopt`](../chapters/cli-tools.qmd) |
| `exit code` | kode keluar | the number a process returns to its caller | [CLI tools with `parseopt`](../chapters/cli-tools.qmd) |
| `entry point` | pintu masuk | the first file or procedure that runs | [CLI tools with `parseopt`](../chapters/cli-tools.qmd) |
| `route` | rute | the mapping from an HTTP path and method to a handler | [An HTTP API with `asynchttpserver`](../chapters/http-api.qmd) |
| `handler` | pengendali | the function that handles one request or event | [An HTTP API with `asynchttpserver`](../chapters/http-api.qmd) |
| `socket` | soket | the endpoint of a network connection used by servers and clients | [An HTTP API with `asynchttpserver`](../chapters/http-api.qmd) |
| `row` | baris | one record in a table or query result | [Storing data: `Table`, JSON, and SQLite](../chapters/database.qmd) |
| `query` | kueri | a request for data from a database | [Storing data: `Table`, JSON, and SQLite](../chapters/database.qmd) |
| `transaction` | transaksi | a group of changes that must all succeed or none at all | [Storing data: `Table`, JSON, and SQLite](../chapters/database.qmd) |
| `package` | paket | a distributable unit of code that can be installed | [Building and publishing a nimble package](../chapters/nimble-packages.qmd) |
| `maintainer` | pemelihara | the person responsible for looking after a package | [Building and publishing a nimble package](../chapters/nimble-packages.qmd) |

New terms go into the master list first, and only then into a chapter.
